name: Stranglethorn Fever
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, Witch Doctor Unbagwa prepares a chant to draw Mokk the Savage from the jungle. He needs ten Gorilla Fangs to begin. As he communes with the spirits, nearby gorillas come to threaten him.

sections.title: A Ritual for the Savage
sections.body: Witch Doctor Unbagwa knows a ritual that can draw Mokk the Savage from the jungle. He asks for ten Gorilla Fangs before beginning the chant. As he communes with the spirits, the chant draws nearby gorillas. They threaten the witch doctor while he tries to finish the ritual.

faq.answer: Witch Doctor Unbagwa is a troll in Stranglethorn Vale who claims to speak with the spirits and draw out the great ape Mokk the Savage.

faq.q: What does Witch Doctor Unbagwa require to start?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Unbagwa requires ten Gorilla Fangs before he agrees to speak with the spirits.

faq.q: Why must the witch doctor be defended?
faq.answer: Speaking with the spirits draws nearby gorillas to Unbagwa. They threaten him as he communes with the spirits, and he cannot finish or summon Mokk if they overrun him.
Mokk the Savage is a formidable gorilla prowling Stranglethorn Vale, and Witch Doctor Unbagwa knows how to summon him.
